name: Requirements Traceability (IRCC)
tagline: Checks requirements trace to design, stories and tests · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Reconciles requirements with the functional design, Azure DevOps stories and tests, and reports broken links, orphan stories and untested requirements. It returns an exception report and a refreshed traceability matrix for review.
starters: Check traceability for the attached requirement set and RTM
List requirements with no story or test
Which stories don't trace to any requirement?
attachHint: Attach the requirement set (.json) and/or the RTM workbook (.xlsx); optionally the FDD (.json with 'FDD' in the name) and an Azure DevOps export (.json with 'ADO' in the name).
